1. mobile/src/config/walk.ts: demo points [{ atSeconds, meters }] for a ~15-min walk with a 60 s bus ride at ~25 km/h in the middle; FAST_SPEED_KMH = 12, FAST_MIN_SECONDS = 30; a playback rate so the demo lasts ~20 s.
2. mobile/src/lib/simulatedWalk.ts: pure walkStateAt(points, elapsedSeconds) → { durationSeconds, distanceMeters, speedKmh, dizzy, fastStretchOccurred, finished }. Distance grows only at or below FAST_SPEED_KMH; dizzy once above it for FAST_MIN_SECONDS. Plus a useSimulatedWalk() hook with one interval, cleared on finish and unmount.
3. WalkScreen: "Simulate walk" button; live duration, km, km/h; while dizzy, en.json line "{{name}} feels dizzy, so the distance is paused." On finish, use the existing onWalkState(false) path.

5. Dizzy dog: App → DogLayer → DogStage `dizzy` prop, class is-dizzy: slow wobble + 2–3 circling stars (transform/opacity; still under prefers-reduced-motion). Ignore taps while dizzy.
6. mock/milestones.ts gentleNote: move to en.json with {{name}}, no "he".
Out of scope: api/, shared/, migrations/, lib/api.ts, scene files, Home, Health.
